info.title: MPLS_Static_LSP_Binding
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [MPLS_Static_LSP_Binding](#/MPLS_Static_LSP_Binding)
Reference to MPLS Static LSP Binding attributes.

in_label.description: Label of the ingress packet. This column value can be empty.

in_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Ingress port. This column value can be empty.

in_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
The VRF to which the ingress packets matching this MPLS Static LSP binding belongs to. This column value can be empty.

nexthop_ip.description: IP address of the nexthop device. Should be a valid interface  IP address. The following IPv4 and IPv6 address formats are  accepted. IPv4 format (A.B.C.D), IPv6 format (A:B::C:D). This  column value can be empty.

operation.description: 'push':  Add label to ingress Packet (Label imposition) 'pop':   Remove label from egress packet (Label disposition) 'swap':  Replace the label of ingress packet 'swap-implicit': Remove the label of ingress packet.                   Used in Penultimate Hop Pop (PHP) 'swap-explicit': Replace the label of ingress packet with                   explicit NULL. Used in Penultimate Hop Pop (PHP)

out_label.description: Label of the egress packet. This column value can be empty.

out_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Egress port. This column value can be empty.

out_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
The VRF to which the egress packets matching this MPLS Static LSP binding belongs to.

prefix.description: IPv4 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format.  Example 192.168.0.0/16.  IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format.  Example 2001:0DB8:0000:000b::/64.  This column value can be empty.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty  when state is 'accepted'

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
